source_owner: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
definition: The official 2024 survey task specification routes the Middle East group under English and explicitly lists Uzbekistan; Turkey; Israel; Iran; Kazakhstan; Jordan; Saudi Arabia; Iraq; Kyrgyzstan; Syria; Lebanon; United Arab Emirates; Kuwait; Republic of Yemen; Oman; Tajikistan; Bahrain; Palestine; Cyprus; Qatar; Turkmenistan.
methodology: same-year official procurement/task specification for survey execution and questionnaire-language routing
limitations: This verifies the intended 2024 operational Middle East constituent frame in the task specification. It does not by itself prove the final raw country-code values, final respondent classification implementation, realized country counts, or whether any fieldwork deviation occurred.

source_owner: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
definition: Official task specification states survey languages as English, Japanese, Chinese simplified/traditional, Thai, German, French, Russian, Filipino, Vietnamese, Indonesian and Mongolian, described as 12 languages; English is assigned to Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, the specified Middle East group, and Other countries.
limitations: The source describes planned language routing, not respondent-level language used. The official wording '12 languages' is preserved without re-counting Chinese variants or inferring questionnaire files.

source_owner: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
definition: The official request for proposals states that the survey's existing 'Middle East' respondents contain a substantial share of Central Asians, mostly Kazakhstan respondents, and requests consideration of increasing the share of actual Middle Eastern respondents in consultation with the commissioning body.
methodology: same-year official procurement note identifying a known composition issue in the Middle East survey group
limitations: This is a design/fieldwork warning, not a realized-sample estimate. No percentage of Central Asian or Kazakhstan respondents is stated, so no numeric composition is inferred.

source_owner: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
definition: The operational 'Middle East' label is not a pure geographic Middle East classification because its stated frame includes Central Asian countries and other transregional states.
methodology: direct consequence of the official enumerated frame; no external geography harmonization applied
limitations: Do not remap this survey label to a standard geopolitical Middle East definition or compare it to external Middle East aggregates without an explicit bridge table. Raw country-code extraction remains required.
